payload_profiles.description: Canonicalize the exact closed contract object after omitting only its top-level record_digest_sha256 member. No domain prefix is added.
Canonicalize the exact approved evidence manifest after omitting only its top-level bundle_digest_sha256 member. No domain prefix is added.
Project exactly the registered artifact and operational admission-scope fields from one immutable clearance decision, preserving conditions and limitations array order.

Canonicalize exactly the named request fields, resolving the requested location URL and a conditional basis to its pinned bundle id, sequence, digest and event code; null conditional members remain explicit.
Canonicalize the complete principal_roster array after requiring ascending id and the exact five closed item members.
Canonicalize the complete state_payload object, including nulls and every nested digest; no member is omitted.
Hash the exact named repository file bytes, including their existing line endings and final-byte state, without parsing or normalization.
Hash the exact executable release bytes selected by the sibling runtime role or scanner code.
Hash the exact dependency-lock file bytes for the sibling component release.
Hash the exact closed SQLite candidate file bytes named by the containing seal or journal event; this is not the logical-state digest.
Hash the exact scanner rules/signature-set bytes selected by the sibling scanner code.
Hash the exact noncredential runtime-domain marker bytes retained with the protected profile generation; the marker is never caller supplied.
Hash the exact operational-profile file bytes identified by the sibling kind, code and generation.
Hash the exact collector request-policy/configuration file bytes used for the handoff.
Hash the exact supporting-record bytes selected by supporting_record_code; the digest does not itself establish rights.
Hash the exact bounded scanner-result record bytes selected by scanner code, build, rules and completion time.
Hash the exact adapter durability-receipt bytes bound to the request digest and resulting backend reference.
Hash the exact backup-inventory file bytes for the containing operation and generation.
Hash the exact incident-record bytes reviewed by the recovery authority.
Hash the exact restore-plan bytes authorized for the recovery operation.
Hash the exact noncanonical completion-repair plan bytes authorized for the post-promotion recovery operation.
Hash exactly byte_length bytes at the sibling byte_layer_code, with no decoding, decompression or normalization.
Hash the exact migration file bytes selected by the sibling migration_name.
Select sqlite_schema rows whose names do not start sqlite_; project {type,name,table_name,sql}, preserving SQL and null exactly, and order by type then name with BINARY.
Apply the complete-schema projection, then exclude names beginning atlas_ and the exact names schema_migrations and migration_checksums.

Project every declared column, retaining deterministic integer IDs and foreign-key IDs; encode BLOB as {blob_hex}; order by every declared column in PRAGMA table_info order using BINARY. No FK-to-code substitution occurs in v1.
Project one receipt without its local id, resolving its three principal FKs to stable codes, with exactly the twelve named members.
Select sqlite_schema rows whose names do not start sqlite_; project {type,name,table_name} and order by type then name with BINARY.
Canonicalize every accepted receipt and the exact ordered dependency references from its retained manifest.
Canonicalize the frozen legacy, API, frontend, export, search, migration and Tranche 2B surface inventory and exact content hashes.
Resolve the exact bitemporal migration-005 custody leaf, replace foreign keys with stable codes and its receipt tuple, and canonicalize every named semantic field without omission.

schema_inventories.select_sql: SELECT type,name,tbl_name AS table_name,sql FROM sqlite_schema WHERE substr(name,1,7) <> 'sqlite_' ORDER BY type COLLATE BINARY ASC,name COLLATE BINARY ASC

SELECT type,name,tbl_name AS table_name,sql FROM sqlite_schema WHERE substr(name,1,7) <> 'sqlite_' AND substr(name,1,6) <> 'atlas_' AND name NOT IN ('schema_migrations','migration_checksums') ORDER BY type COLLATE BINARY ASC,name COLLATE BINARY ASC
SELECT type,name,tbl_name AS table_name FROM sqlite_schema WHERE substr(name,1,7) <> 'sqlite_' ORDER BY type COLLATE BINARY ASC,name COLLATE BINARY ASC
